data.name: After the End
data.detailed_description:
🌑 After The End

After the End is a top-down dark fantasy action RPG set in a broken world after Ragnarok, where exploration replaces guidance and meaning must be found, not given.

Ragnarok came.
The world did not end.

It simply… broke.

You awaken on a shattered northern shore with no memory, marked by a faint rune glowing beneath your skin.

Midgard lies quiet and wounded. Villages have burned. Forests twist with something unnatural. The gods are gone, but their absence has not brought peace.

Something lingers.

Something watches.

And somehow, it knows you.

🗡️ Deliberate, Weighty Combat

Combat is grounded, dangerous, and intentional.
Every encounter demands awareness. Timing, positioning, and restraint matter more than speed.

Enemies are not obstacles. They are threats.

From stalking Dökkálfar to coordinated wolf packs and lingering spirits, each enemy behaves differently and forces you to adapt.

🌲 Exploration Without Guidance

There are no glowing markers. No forced paths.

You are free to wander through ruined villages, frozen coastlines, forgotten shrines, and shadowed forests, discovering what matters by instinct, not instruction.

If something feels important, it probably is.

📜 A World That Speaks in Fragments

The story is not handed to you.

It lives in what remains. In abandoned homes, broken structures, and the words of those still clinging to life.

Every place holds a piece of something larger.
Understanding it is up to you.

🛡️ A Rune That Shouldn’t Exist

The mark beneath your skin reacts to the world, and the world reacts to it.

Its origin is unclear.
Its purpose is worse.

As it grows, so does your connection to something long forgotten.

⚖️ Shape Your Path

Develop your character through two distinct paths:

  • The Way of Valor — precision, strength, and mastery of combat

  • The Way of the Seer — intuition, runes, and remnants of lost magic

Each path offers power, but neither offers answers.

🧳 Relics of a Broken Age

Weapons and armor are remnants of what came before, worn, altered, and etched with purpose.

Nothing is pristine.
Everything has a history.

What you carry may matter more than you realize.

🐺 Creatures That Endured

You are not alone in what remains.

Creatures shaped by divine ruin still roam the land. Some driven by instinct, others by something far more unsettling.

Every encounter carries risk.
Every victory feels earned.

📖 A Living Record of Your Journey

Track your discoveries through a physical journal, flipping between quests, maps, skills, and notes like a record of something slowly being uncovered.

🕯️ What Remains

You are not a hero.

You are not chosen.

But the world reacts to you as if you matter,
and that may be the most dangerous thing of all.

🔶 Development Note

After the End is in active development.
Systems, visuals, and content continue to evolve as the world expands.

This page exists to share progress, gather feedback, and build something meaningful together.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains depictions of violence, death, and unsettling themes. Combat includes blood effects and the use of weapons such as axes and swords. Some environments depict corpses, ruined villages, and supernatural horror elements inspired by Norse mythology.

While not overly graphic, the tone is somber and mature, dealing with loss, survival, and the aftermath of catastrophic events.
